script_bundle.title: How MCP Authorization Works End-to-End (OAuth 2.1 & RFC 8693 OBO)
script_bundle.gcp_stack: Google Cloud ADK + Cloud Run MCP Gateway + Cloud IAM STS (RFC 8693) + Model Armor
script_bundle.full_spoken_script: Welcome to briefing MCP-AUTH-V2: How MCP Authorization Works End-to-End (OAuth 2.1 & RFC 8693 OBO). In production enterprise deployments, 6-phase, 16-message zero-trust MCP OAuth 2.1 flow combining RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata, CIMD client identity, PKCE S256 + RFC 9207 mix-up. Act two isolates ingress routing and dynamic Top-K tool discovery so static schema dumps never pollute the context window. Act three enforces zero-trust OAuth 2.1 On-Behalf-Of token exchange and deterministic policy guardrails on blueprint T222. Act four maps the runtime onto Google Cloud ADK + Cloud Run MCP Gateway + Cloud IAM STS (RFC 8693) + Model Armor with immutable OpenTelemetry provenance and cryptographic execution receipts. Across our 100-trial evaluation suite in repository gcp-breakout-mcp-oauth21-obo-enterprise, we achieve 0% token passthrough • 100% per-user RLS via RFC 8693 OBO • 98.0% 100-trial security eval pass, ready for LinkedIn, YouTube, and GitHub.
